metaDescription: Book a private Galle day tour with Hai Sri Lanka. Visit Galle Fort, southern beaches, and coastal highlights with a local expert.
shortDescription: Explore Galle Fort, beaches, and southern coastal heritage in one private day.
overview: A full-day private journey from Colombo or surrounding areas to Galle Fort, Dutch architecture, stilt fishermen viewpoints, and the southern coastline led by an experienced local guide.
